summaryTh: สมมติเรื่องในอดีตที่ไม่ได้เกิดจริง และผลที่จะเกิดขึ้นในอดีต

concept.what: Third conditional ใช้พูดถึงอดีตที่ "ไม่ได้เป็นแบบนั้นจริง" แล้วจินตนาการว่าถ้าเป็นแบบนั้นผลในอดีตจะต่างไปอย่างไร โครงสร้าง: If + had + V3, would have + V3
when: เสียดายหรือคิดย้อนเรื่องที่ผ่านไปแล้ว (If I had studied, I would have passed.)
วิจารณ์หรือตำหนิสิ่งที่เกิดไปแล้ว (If you had listened, this wouldn't have happened.)
บอกความโล่งใจว่าโชคดีที่ไม่เกิด (If he hadn't braked, he would have hit the dog.)
ใช้ could have / might have แทน would have เมื่อหมายถึง "อาจจะ/สามารถ"
concept.why: ภาษาไทยพูดว่า "ถ้ารู้ก็คงไปแล้ว" โดยไม่เปลี่ยนรูปกริยา แต่ภาษาอังกฤษต้องถอย tense ไปไกลถึง had + V3 เพื่อบอกว่าเรื่องนี้ "ไม่ได้เกิดจริง และจบไปแล้ว" ถ้าใช้ If I knew … จะกลายเป็นสมมติเรื่องตอนนี้

structure.formula: If + Subject + had + V3, Subject + would have + V3

rows.label: บอกเล่า (Positive)
rows.formula: If + had + V3, would have + V3
rows.example: If we [[had left]] earlier, we [[would have caught]] the train.

rows.label: ปฏิเสธ (Negative)
rows.formula: If + hadn't + V3, wouldn't have + V3
rows.example: If it [[hadn't rained]], we [[wouldn't have cancelled]] the trip.

rows.label: คำถาม (Question)
rows.formula: What would you have + V3 + if + had + V3?
rows.example: What [[would]] you [[have done]] if you [[had lost]] your passport?

rows.label: could / might
rows.formula: If + had + V3, could/might have + V3
rows.example: If she [[had applied]], she [[might have got]] the job.

rows.label: สลับ if (ทางการ)
rows.formula: Had + Subject + V3, would have + V3

notes: สลับประโยคได้: I would have helped if you had asked. (ไม่ต้องมีจุลภาค)
ภาษาพูดย่อเป็น I'd have / would've / I'd known — ระวัง 'd อาจเป็น had หรือ would
ไม่ใช้ would ในประโยค if: If I had known (ไม่ใช่ If I would have known)
had had = had (กริยาแท้ช่อง 3) ใช้ได้ถูกต้อง: If I had had time, I would have called.

examples.en: If I [[had known]] about the party, I [[would have gone]].
examples.th: ถ้าฉันรู้เรื่องปาร์ตี้ ฉันคงไปแล้ว (แต่ไม่รู้ เลยไม่ได้ไป)

examples.en: We [[wouldn't have got]] lost if we [[had used]] the map app.
examples.th: พวกเราคงไม่หลงทาง ถ้าใช้แอปแผนที่

examples.en: If she [[hadn't missed]] the bus, she [[would have arrived]] on time.
examples.th: ถ้าเธอไม่พลาดรถเมล์ เธอคงมาทันเวลา

examples.en: If you [[had told]] me earlier, I [[could have helped]] you.
examples.th: ถ้าคุณบอกฉันเร็วกว่านี้ ฉันคงช่วยคุณได้

examples.en: He [[might have won]] the race if he [[hadn't fallen]].
examples.th: เขาอาจจะชนะการแข่งขัน ถ้าเขาไม่ล้ม

examples.en: What [[would]] you [[have done]] if the hotel [[had been]] full?
examples.th: ถ้าตอนนั้นโรงแรมเต็ม คุณจะทำอย่างไร (แต่จริง ๆ โรงแรมไม่เต็ม)

examples.en: If I [[had checked]] my email, I [[wouldn't have missed]] the meeting.
examples.th: ถ้าฉันเช็กอีเมล ฉันคงไม่พลาดการประชุม

examples.en: [[Had]] they [[booked]] earlier, they [[would have got]] cheaper tickets.
examples.th: ถ้าพวกเขาจองเร็วกว่านี้ คงได้ตั๋วราคาถูกกว่า (แบบทางการ)

mistakes.wrong: If I would have known, I would have come.
mistakes.right: If I had known, I would have come.
mistakes.whyTh: ประโยค if ใช้ had + V3 ไม่ใช้ would — would อยู่ฝั่งผลลัพธ์เท่านั้น

mistakes.wrong: If I knew about the test, I would have studied.
mistakes.right: If I had known about the test, I would have studied.
mistakes.whyTh: เรื่องสอบจบไปแล้ว ฝั่ง if ต้องถอยเป็น had + V3 (knew ใช้สมมติปัจจุบัน)

mistakes.wrong: If she had studied, she would passed.
mistakes.right: If she had studied, she would have passed.
mistakes.whyTh: ฝั่งผลลัพธ์ต้องเป็น would have + V3 ห้ามขาด have

mistakes.wrong: If we had left earlier, we will have caught the train.
mistakes.right: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.
mistakes.whyTh: สมมติอดีตที่ไม่จริงใช้ would ไม่ใช่ will

mistakes.wrong: If he had came, he would have enjoyed it.
mistakes.right: If he had come, he would have enjoyed it.
mistakes.whyTh: หลัง had ต้องใช้ V3: come – came – come (ไม่ใช่ came)

compare.title: Second Conditional vs Third Conditional

rows.label: เวลา
rows.a: ปัจจุบัน/อนาคต ที่ไม่จริงหรือไม่น่าเป็นไปได้
rows.b: อดีตที่ไม่ได้เกิดจริง (จบไปแล้ว เปลี่ยนไม่ได้)

rows.label: โครงสร้าง
rows.b: If + had + V3, would have + V3

rows.label: ตัวอย่าง
rows.a: If I had more time, I would help you. (ตอนนี้ไม่มีเวลา)
rows.b: If I had had more time, I would have helped you. (ตอนนั้นไม่มีเวลา)

compare.tipTh: ถามตัวเองว่าเรื่องนี้ "ผ่านไปแล้วหรือยัง" ถ้าผ่านไปแล้วและเปลี่ยนไม่ได้ ใช้ Third conditional

lines.text: Last Friday, Krit overslept because his phone battery died during the night. He missed the bus and arrived at the exam twenty minutes late. "If I [[had charged]] my phone, I [[would have woken]] up on time," he said. "And if I [[hadn't missed]] the bus, I [[wouldn't have lost]] twenty minutes."

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: We lost 2–1, but it was close.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: If Nok [[hadn't got]] injured, we [[would have won]].

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: Maybe. And if we [[had trained]] harder, we [[might have scored]] more goals.

terms.th: ประโยคเงื่อนไขสมมติอดีตที่ไม่ได้เกิดจริง
ส่วนเงื่อนไข (ประโยคที่มี if)
ส่วนผลลัพธ์ (would have + V3)
อดีตที่ไม่จริง — สิ่งที่ไม่ได้เกิดขึ้น
ความเสียดาย

practice.question: If I had known about the party last Saturday, I ___.

whyNot.1: would go เป็นผลในปัจจุบัน/อนาคต แต่ปาร์ตี้จบไปแล้ว (last Saturday)
whyNot.2: will go ใช้กับเงื่อนไขที่เป็นไปได้จริง ไม่ใช่สมมติอดีต
whyNot.3: had gone อยู่ฝั่ง if ฝั่งผลต้องเป็น would have + V3

practice.explainTh: สมมติอดีตที่ไม่จริง (ไม่รู้ เลยไม่ได้ไป) → If + had + V3, would have + V3
practice.structure: If + had + V3, would have + V3
practice.example: If I had known, I would have gone.

practice.question: If we ___ (leave) earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.
accepted: had left
practice.explainTh: ฝั่ง if ของ Third conditional ใช้ had + V3 → had left (ความจริงคือออกช้า เลยตกรถไฟ)

practice.question: She ___ (not / fail) the exam if she had studied harder.
accepted: wouldn't have failed
would not have failed
might not have failed
practice.explainTh: ฝั่งผลของ Third conditional: would + not + have + V3 → wouldn't have failed (might not have failed = อาจจะไม่ตก ก็ถูก)

practice.sentence: If he would have called me, I would have helped him.
accepted: If he had called me, I would have helped him.
If he'd called me, I would have helped him.
Had he called me, I would have helped him.
practice.explainTh: ประโยค if ไม่ใช้ would ต้องใช้ had + V3 → If he had called me
practice.structure: If + had + V3, would have + V3

practice.question: We would have won yesterday's match if our best player ___ injured in the first half.

whyNot.1: didn't get เป็นรูปของ Second conditional (สมมติปัจจุบัน) แต่การบาดเจ็บเกิดในแมตช์เมื่อวาน
whyNot.2: ฝั่ง if ไม่ใช้ would
whyNot.3: hasn't got เป็น Present Perfect ใช้สมมติอดีตไม่ได้

practice.explainTh: การบาดเจ็บเกิดในอดีตและผลก็อยู่ในอดีต → If + hadn't + V3: hadn't got injured

practice.source: I didn't have an umbrella, so I got wet.
practice.instruction: เขียนใหม่เป็น Third conditional ขึ้นต้นด้วย If I … และใช้ wet
accepted: If I had had an umbrella, I wouldn't have got wet.
If I had had an umbrella I wouldn't have got wet.
If I had had an umbrella, I wouldn't have gotten wet.
If I had had an umbrella I wouldn't have gotten wet.
If I'd had an umbrella, I wouldn't have got wet.
If I'd had an umbrella I wouldn't have got wet.
If I'd had an umbrella, I wouldn't have gotten wet.
If I'd had an umbrella I wouldn't have gotten wet.
practice.explainTh: ความจริง: ไม่มีร่ม → สมมติตรงข้าม: had had (had + V3 ของ have) · ผล: เปียก → wouldn't have got wet (AmE: gotten)
practice.structure: If + had + V3, wouldn't have + V3

practice.source: She was late because the bus broke down.
practice.instruction: เขียนใหม่ ขึ้นต้นด้วย If the bus … และใช้ late
accepted: If the bus hadn't broken down, she wouldn't have been late.
If the bus hadn't broken down she wouldn't have been late.
If the bus hadn't broken down, she wouldn't have arrived late.
If the bus hadn't broken down she wouldn't have arrived late.
practice.explainTh: ความจริง: รถเสีย → สมมติ hadn't broken down · ความจริง: สาย → wouldn't have been late (break – broke – broken)
practice.structure: If + hadn't + V3, wouldn't have + V3

accepted: If you had asked me I would have helped you.
I would have helped you if you had asked me.
If I had asked you you would have helped me.
You would have helped me if I had asked you.
practice.explainTh: If + had + V3 (had asked), would have + V3 (would have helped) — สลับเอาส่วนผลขึ้นก่อนก็ได้

accepted: She would have passed if she had studied.
If she had studied she would have passed.
practice.explainTh: would have + V3 + if + had + V3 → She would have passed if she had studied.

practice.prompt: จับคู่เงื่อนไขกับผลลัพธ์ที่สมเหตุสมผล
pairs: we would have had a picnic.
If I had set my alarm,
If she had checked the map,
If they had saved more money,
they could have bought the house.
practice.explainTh: ทุกคู่ใช้ If + had + V3, would/could have + V3 — ดูความหมายให้เข้ากัน เช่น ตั้งนาฬิกาปลุก → ไม่ตื่นสาย

practice.question: เลือกประโยคที่ถูกต้อง (ตอนนั้นฉันไม่รู้ว่าคุณป่วย เลยไม่ได้ไปเยี่ยม)
choices: If I had known you were ill, I would have visited you.
If I would have known you were ill, I would have visited you.
If I had known you were ill, I will have visited you.
If I had knew you were ill, I would have visited you.

whyNot.1: ฝั่ง if ไม่ใช้ would ต้องเป็น had + V3
whyNot.2: สมมติอดีตใช้ would have ไม่ใช่ will have
whyNot.3: หลัง had ต้องใช้ V3: known ไม่ใช่ knew

practice.explainTh: If + had known (V3), would have + visited (V3)

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The concert last night was amazing! Why didn't you come?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nobody told me about it! If someone ___ me, I would definitely have come.

whyNot.1: told ใช้กับ Second conditional (สมมติปัจจุบัน) แต่คอนเสิร์ตจบไปแล้ว
whyNot.2: ฝั่ง if ไม่ใช้ would
whyNot.3: has told เป็น Present Perfect ใช้ในประโยคสมมติอดีตไม่ได้

practice.explainTh: ความจริงคือไม่มีใครบอก (อดีต) → สมมติตรงข้าม: If someone had told me, I would have come.

lines.text: Last Friday, Krit overslept because his phone battery died during the night. He missed the bus and arrived at the exam twenty minutes late. "If I had charged my phone, I would have woken up on time," he said. "And if I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have lost twenty minutes."

practice.question: Which sentence is TRUE?
choices: Krit arrived at the exam on time.

whyNot.1: would have woken up on time เป็นการสมมติ ความจริงคือเขาตื่นสาย
whyNot.2: if I hadn't missed the bus บอกว่าความจริงเขาพลาดรถเมล์
whyNot.3: เรื่องบอกว่าเขามาสาย 20 นาที

practice.explainTh: Third conditional พูดตรงข้ามกับความจริง: If I had charged my phone → ความจริงคือเขาไม่ได้ชาร์จ

practice.question: ___ the fire alarm, they would have left the building earlier.

whyNot.1: If they heard เป็น Second conditional ไม่เข้ากับ would have left
whyNot.2: Have they heard เป็นคำถาม Present Perfect ใช้เป็นเงื่อนไขไม่ได้
whyNot.3: Did they hear เป็นคำถาม Past Simple ใช้เป็นเงื่อนไขไม่ได้

practice.explainTh: แบบทางการ ตัด if แล้วสลับ had ขึ้นหน้าประธาน: Had they heard = If they had heard

practice.question: If the doctors hadn't acted so quickly, the patient ___ (might / not / survive).
accepted: might not have survived
mightn't have survived
practice.explainTh: ฝั่งผลของ Third conditional ใช้ might + not + have + V3 → might not have survived (อาจจะไม่รอด)

practice.task: เขียน 3 ประโยค Third conditional เกี่ยวกับเรื่องในอดีตของคุณที่อยากให้ต่างไป (Write 3 third conditional sentences about things in your past.)

checks.msgTh: ใช้ If + had + V3 อย่างน้อย 1 ครั้ง เช่น If I had studied …
ฝั่งผลใช้ would/could/might have + V3 เช่น I would have passed.

practice.sample: If I had studied harder at school, I would have got better grades. If my friend hadn't helped me, I would have failed the maths test. I could have joined the trip if I had saved enough money.
practice.explainTh: ทุกประโยคมีสองส่วน: If + had + V3 (สิ่งที่ไม่ได้เกิดจริง) และ would/could have + V3 (ผลในอดีตที่ไม่ได้เกิด)
